law_name: Law Relating to the Protection of Personal Data and Privacy (Law No. 058/2021)
key_requirements: Lawful processing principles, DPO and impact assessments, breach notification, cross-border transfer rules
retention_period: Art. 52: keep data until processing purposes are fulfilled; longer if authorised by law, required by contract or consent; retention schedule required
penalties_range: Admin fine RWF 2M-5M or 1% global turnover; criminal fines up to 5% of turnover; up to 7 years' imprisonment
deceased_data: Data subject may designate an heir to personal data by will; heir gets full or restricted rights over processing after death (data not subject to succession); article not confirmed
research_exemption: Research purposes are a lawful basis for processing, subject to authorisation by the relevant institution; specific article not confirmed
genetic_data: Sensitive personal data includes genetic information (art. 3(2)); stricter conditions for processing sensitive data
notes: Two-year transition for existing controllers ended 15 Oct 2023
